**Investigating missing JiHostFactory facade****Classifying facade as LocalHostApplication.open(Map)****Confirming missing initial environment credentials**
**Verifying provider authentication limitations****Confirming absence of JiHostFactory source**

CONFIRMED

- `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-spring-boot-starter\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\spring\JiHostProperties.java:8-14` exposes only enabled, data/workspace paths, model, base URL, and port.
- `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-spring-boot-starter\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\spring\JiHostAutoConfiguration.java:21-35` builds a fresh map containing only those values and passes it to `LocalHostApplication.open`; it never merges `System.getenv()` or Spring `Environment`.
- `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-cli\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\cli\LocalHostApplication.java:29-31,101-108` forwards exactly the supplied map, only synthesizing an unconfigured model/base URL when absent.
- `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-cli\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\cli\JiCli.java:154-195` enables credentials only if that map contains nonblank `JI_LLM_API_KEY`; it then requires `JI_CREDENTIAL_MASTER_KEY`. Otherwise it installs `CredentialResolver.none()`.
- Normal CLI/standalone composition passes `System.getenv()` directly (`JiCli.java:43-44`, `JiStandalone.java:30`), confirming Spring is the divergent path.
- Existing Spring tests only verify startup and health without a configured provider, so they do not detect the credential-loss path.
